display_name: Tasco Insurance voluntary motor vehicle insurance rules (Decision 168/2024/QĐ-BH Tasco): own damage, driver and passenger accident with its injury-rate table, owner's liability for goods, voluntary third-party liability, and fifteen additional clauses

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md; the source is an 82-page image scan read by OCR, and every figure and clause number was read from the page images

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the OCR text, in short runs checked by tools/vnsrc.py to occur verbatim in it, and on lines marked `[page-read p.N]` where the page image corrects the OCR. The 1,136 injury-table rows are keyed by printed item number and OCR line, not quoted.

aids: ../../../../../../.aids/law-08-2022-qh15.txt (Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15; consulted for LAW: forks, not encoded)

scope: The whole document: Decision 168/2024 (signed 17/10/2024, effective 15/11/2024, replacing Decision 53/2024), Chapters I-VI of the rules (Articles 1-31, clauses BS01-BS15 and item 16), and the appendix (1,136 injury-table rows, the reduced-sight table, special cases 1-6). Encoded: 104 coverage rows; inert: 15 (recitals, rights lists, notes, the cover letter on page 59); reached-and-refused: 1 (Chapter VI item 16, terms not in the document); deferred: 0. Inputs, not encoded: everything the document leaves to the policy, to an assessment, to Tasco's recorded decision within a band, to the compulsory third-party scheme, and to the tariff. A contract concluded before 15/11/2024 is declined by name. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F-01: Decision Art. 2: effective 15/11/2024, read from the handwriting and the typed page 59.
forks.F-02: These rules govern contracts concluded from 15/11/2024; earlier contracts are declined.
forks.F-03: 'Bên mua bảo hiểm/ Chủ xe' names whichever is the party; duties are put on the policyholder.
forks.F-04: Periods in calendar days; the last day is the event date plus N, inclusive.
forks.F-05: Art. 1.11: months of use as the difference of the month numbers.
forks.F-06: Art. 1.17.2: one straight deductible on the amount payable before it.
forks.F-07: Art. 2.1: the period includes both dates written on the policy.
forks.F-08: LAW: Art. 3.2.1 read as written (termination at will by notice); the Law lists grounds.
forks.F-10: LAW: Art. 9.1's year runs from the loss for every chapter, as written.
forks.F-11: Art. 10.4: the listed modifications save only a certificate made invalid by them alone.
forks.F-12: Art. 10.7: an untested driver is not excluded by it.
forks.F-13: Chapter II settlement order: depreciation, proportion, costs, reduction, deductible, cap, double insurance.
forks.F-14: Riot vandalism by others is a malicious act under Art. 11.1.5.
forks.F-15: Art. 13.7: the closing exception qualifies the whole list.
forks.F-16: Art. 15.1.3(d): the battery table is read by the battery's time in use.
forks.F-17: Art. 15.1.5: the larger of the policy's deductible and 500.000 đồng.
forks.F-18: Art. 15.1.5: the minimum applies to a partial loss only.
forks.F-19: A clause's deductible replaces the chapter's when larger.
forks.F-20: 'khi xe đang hoạt động' limits only Art. 10.5 and 10.7.
forks.F-21: At exactly 50% over the speed limit the Art. 10.11 exclusion applies.
forks.F-22: Art. 20.2.1: up to and including 100 million.
forks.F-23: Art. 25: sum per tonne times tonnes damaged, or the actual damage if less.
forks.F-25: Art. 28 and 29: the formula, never more than the excess over the compulsory limit.
forks.F-26: BS04: contract length from the start to the end of its last day.
forks.F-27: BS07: 30 days of hire paid, after the 04-day deductible.
forks.F-28: Art. 20.2.2(a): the least of costs, 0,3% per day and the table amount.
forks.F-29: Special case 4: injuries summed and capped once.
forks.F-30: LAW: Art. 14.1.1(b)'s flat 10% applied as written; the Law's Art. 46 is narrower.
forks.F-31: LAW: Art. 14.1.3(a)'s band applied as written; the Law's Art. 54.1(b) ties it to fault.
forks.F-32: Art. 8: double insurance only when the sums insured together exceed the market value.
